# Go

Go builds a module with nothing extra to install: `GOOS=wasip1` is a target of the Go you already have, and the whole standard library comes along. The cost is size. The summary example is 4.3 MB: its first call compiles it for about a second, and later calls load 18 MB of machine code from the cache in about 38 ms. That's fine off the hot path: a cron job, an import, an admin action. For a module that runs on every save or every request, build the same code with [TinyGo](/docs/extensions/wasm/languages/tinygo) instead: 3 ms and under 1 MB a call.

## The module

[`example/summary/go`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/wasm/example/summary/go/main.go) is a plain command-line program:

```go
//go:embed manifest.json
var manifest string // what `summary --describe` prints

func main() {
	switch os.Args[1] { // the function asked for
	case "--describe":
		fmt.Print(manifest)
		return
	case "run":
	default:
		fail("no_such_function", os.Args[1])
	}
	var post struct {
		Title string `json:"title"`
		Body  string `json:"body"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&post); err != nil {
		fail("bad_input", "the input isn't a post: "+err.Error())
	}
	// ... the summary
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"text": text, "words": len(words)})
}

// fail ends the program with an error your code can read (err.code / err.message).
func fail(code, message string) {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"code": code, "message": message})
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, string(b))
	os.Exit(1)
}
```

## Build

```bash
GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm go build -o pb_hooks/summary.pb.wasm .
```

`-ldflags="-s -w"` saves little here (about 80 KB of 4.4 MB). A Go module always says it's Go, so its manifest needs no `language`.

## Call it

An API route that saves a post with its summary:

```ts
// pb_pages/posts.ts
export async function post(ctx: any) {
  const { title, body } = ctx.req.body()
  const out = await $wasm.run.async<{ text: string }>("summary", { title, body })
  const record = new Record(ctx.app.findCollectionByNameOrId("posts"))
  record.load({ title, body, summary: out.text })
  ctx.app.save(record)
  return ctx.res.json(201, { id: record.id, summary: out.text })
}
```

## Size

What you import sets the size. The summary (`encoding/json`, `strings`, `fmt`) is 4.3 MB; a module that imports `net/http` is about 11 MB, over the default `MaxModulesMB` of 10, so it can't run until that's raised. Two Go calls run at once with the defaults, and calls that compile at the same time slow each other down ([Which language](/docs/extensions/wasm/extension#which-language) has the numbers).

## What doesn't work

`GOOS=wasip1` programs get no files, no network and no environment here. `net` builds but reaches nothing outside the program, and goroutines run, one at a time. A library (`-buildmode=c-shared`) isn't a program and is refused when it loads.
